topic: What net present value answers for a deal.
goal: Explain NPV as a hurdle-rate test, not a cash total.
grill: I keep forgetting what NPV is for.
I discount cash flows in a deal model.
I think NPV is just the sum of the cash flows.

interjections.text: it's really irritating me how you teach me something in an output and it disappears before I can read it

facts.claim: A discount rate is the return the investor could get elsewhere.
NPV discounts future cash flows to today.
NPV asks whether the deal beats the hurdle rate, so a positive NPV adds value.
facts.wrong: NPV is just the total of all cash flows.
